summary: Household of 2, no children, earned income about $1,169,600/year. Income is far above the limits for every programme: SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, Medicaid, CHIP and school meals. EITC and CTC don't apply because there are no children and the income is too high. ACA premium tax credit is capped at 400% of the federal poverty level. No further questions needed.
